body:
## Problem
Price anomalies are only detected reactively. Proactive detection could identify issues before they affect consumers.

## Requirements
- Implement moving average deviation detection
- Add z-score based anomaly detection
- Implement volatility-based alerts
- Use historical patterns for baseline

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Multiple anomaly detection algorithms implemented
- [ ] Configurable sensitivity per asset
- [ ] False positive rate tracked
- [ ] Anomaly scores in price metadata
title: Implement proactive anomaly detection in price feeds using statistical methods
